dedupe_keys.name: cern borehole dataset near sps and lhc tunnels

description: Zahra Hajihashemi and collaborators at University College Cork and CERN publish seventy-three borehole logs near the SPS and LHC tunnels in the Geneva Basin across France and Switzerland. The February 2026 deposit contains original PDF logs and raw and harmonised Excel workbooks, free under CC BY 4.0. The README describes one-metre segments, lithology translated from French into English, WGS84 and CH1903+ LV95 coordinates, and SI units. Ground elevation is above sea level and layer depths are below ground, allowing calculation of layer elevations. These records can constrain geological models for tunnel, foundation or critical-facility simulations. Historical drilling dates and complete spatial representativeness remain unknown. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this compilation. Harmonisation can simplify original lithological distinctions, and transcription uncertainty requires checking against source logs. Only the README and inventory were reviewed; numerical records were not downloaded.
